entities.summary: Otoman Zar-Adusht Ha'nish was the founder of a new religious movement known as Mazdaznan. He was born Ernst Otto Haenisch, a German immigrant from Poznań, son of the grocer (victualer) Heinrich Ernst Haenisch and his wife Anna Dorothea nee Schmidt. He was baptized on December 28, 1856.
